title: Qliphoth, Angels, Valkyries, Ladder, Trees and North Cosmology
status: comparative mythology/theology atlas with Potatoverse synthesis
purpose: Integrate lower/upper tree architecture: qelipot/qliphoth, demons, Roots of Strife/Ash, Tree of Knowledge, Tree of Strife and Mud Tree on one side; Tree of Life, House, covenant, Jacob's Ladder, angels, valkyries, Axis of North, North Pole, North of North, Spudlight and Potato angels on the other. The emphasis is now on functions, transitions and boundary ethics rather than one-to-one identity claims.
epistemic_rule: Jewish Kabbalah, biblical angelology, Christian apocalyptic imagery and Norse valkyrie traditions are distinct historical systems. Potatoverse relationships are comparative/synthetic and must not be presented as original doctrine of those traditions or evidence of literal supernatural beings in modern people.

kabbalah.sefirot: Ten sefirot are central kabbalistic emanational/aspect symbols through which the infinite Ein Sof is described in relation to the world.
kabbalah.qelipot: Qelipot/kelipot means husks or shells. In Zoharic/Lurianic frameworks they are associated with the 'other side', impurity/evil and trapped sparks; Lurianic shevirat ha-kelim ('breaking of the vessels') provides a major myth in which divine sparks become trapped among broken shells and tikkun is the work of repair/reintegration.

potatoverse_crosswalk.holy_spark: Seed of Life / Spudlight fragment / recoverable generative potential
potatoverse_crosswalk.shell_husk: rigid enclosure that captures or feeds on value without producing autonomous life
potatoverse_crosswalk.breaking_vessels: fracture that can either liberate/reconfigure or create debris/Mud depending what follows
potatoverse_crosswalk.sitra_ahra: comparative neighbor for Shadow/Swamp only; not declared identical

house_shell_revelation.insight: House and qliphothic shell are both containers, but their ethics run opposite directions.
house_shell_revelation.house: protects differentiated rooms, supports identity, preserves passage and allows each inhabitant to become more itself
house_shell_revelation.shell: captures sparks/value, hardens dependency, obstructs passage and feeds on enclosure
house_shell_revelation.door_test: A healthy House has Doors. A destructive shell increasingly makes exit, translation or reintegration difficult.
house_shell_revelation.formula: BoundaryQuality = protected_differentiation + passage + autonomous_growth - capture - coercion - extraction_dependency
house_shell_revelation.why_it_matters: This makes House/Rooms, Cube, Farm and Qliphoth part of one boundary ethic without declaring them historically identical.

lower_tree.roots_of_strife: unresolved injury, humiliation, fear, resentment, status hunger, extraction incentives, archived grievance and dehumanizing classification
lower_tree.roots_of_ash: post-destruction residue: what remains after conflict, sacrifice, burned relationship or collapsed identity
lower_tree.ash_revelation: Ash is a Door state. It can be mixed into Mud and preserve/reproduce Strife, or returned to Soil and support new growth.
lower_tree.mud_tree: Tree whose soil is accumulated unresolved residue; grows where conflict, archives and incentives make Strife easier to reproduce
lower_tree.tree_of_knowledge: upstream informational tree; knowledge itself can feed Life or Strife depending relation, incentive and consequence
lower_tree.tree_of_strife: branching structure where knowledge/attention becomes exposure→provocation→humiliation→retaliation→archive→further exposure
lower_tree.qliphothic_reading: A Strife branch becomes qliphothic in the project when shell/enclosure persists by capturing sparks/attention/value while obstructing reintegration or autonomous growth.
lower_tree.demons: Treat demons as archetypal/personified patterns of compulsion, fragmentation, predation, distortion or enclosure in this comparative layer unless describing a tradition's own literal demonology.

upper_tree.tree_of_life: nourishment, differentiation-with-unity, repair, fruit, seed, relation and continued generativity
upper_tree.house: stable containment in which differentiated rooms/children can live without being flattened
upper_tree.covenant: persistent edge carrying promise, obligation, sign, memory and repair after breach
upper_tree.jacobs_ladder: Genesis 28 depicts a sullam with angels of God ascending and descending; scholarly interpretation connects it with movement, divine presence and Jacob's departure/return.
upper_tree.angels: Biblical Hebrew mal'akh fundamentally means messenger; angelic beings function as agents/messengers rather than generic winged humans in the earliest textual sense.
upper_tree.valkyries: Old Norse valkyrjur ('choosers of the slain') are female supernatural figures associated with battle-death selection, Odin and movement of chosen warriors toward Valhalla in later literary tradition.
upper_tree.axis: Tree/Ladder functions as a vertical connective structure linking levels/realms; Potatoverse identifies this connective function with Axis/Ladder while preserving tradition-specific differences.

angel_demon_functional_model.angelic_function: messenger, guide, carrier of orientation, protector, mediator, upward/downward relay
angel_demon_functional_model.demonic_function: capture, compulsion, fragmentation, false enclosure, parasitic extraction, distortion
angel_demon_functional_model.door_relation: Angel = relay through a Door that preserves or increases agency; demon = pattern that hijacks, blocks, loops or weaponizes the Door.
angel_demon_functional_model.handshake_relation: Angelic handshake creates relation without erasing the other endpoint; demonic handshake increases dependency, compulsion or capture in the project model.
angel_demon_functional_model.moral_boundary: Do not label disliked people as demons. Store the function on behavior/relation when possible.

identity_to_infrastructure.insight: The upper cosmology repeatedly transforms beings/symbols into relational functions.
identity_to_infrastructure.meaning: The mature sacred role is not only a title but an enabling function that others can traverse, receive, inhabit or orient by.
identity_to_infrastructure.contrast: Qliphothic transformation moves in the opposite direction: relation becomes shell, interface becomes trap, boundary becomes capture.

shared_structure: movement between human and higher realm
valkyrie_angel_bridge.difference: Biblical angels are messengers/agents of God across many contexts; valkyries are specifically Norse female figures strongly tied to battle, slain warriors and Odin. They are not historically the same beings.
valkyrie_angel_bridge.potatoverse_use: Valkyrie can model a fierce psychopomp/selector role on the Ladder; angel can model messenger/guardian/relay. Both are typed carriers on the Axis rather than interchangeable species.

ladder_as_sequence_of_doors.insight: Ladder is better modeled as ordered thresholds than identical rungs.
ladder_as_sequence_of_doors.sequence: Root/Soil → spinal Gates → Heart/Door → Throat → Eye → Crown/House/North → Spudlight → North of North
ladder_as_sequence_of_doors.meaning: Each transition can have a different symbolic, psychological and bodily condition. The model does not imply chakras are literal measured spinal organs.

north_cosmology.north_pole: Physical geographic rotational pole of Earth; in Potatoverse also a mythic anchor for Son death/transformation and vertical orientation.
north_cosmology.axis_of_north: organized orientation structure: North becomes Axis when it connects multiple levels, states, people or institutions.
north_cosmology.north_of_north: meta-orientation: the criterion by which orientations themselves are judged or selected rather than simply a location farther north.
north_cosmology.formula: North = reference; AxisNorth = ordered relation/flow to reference; NorthOfNorth = meta-reference / reference-selection criterion.
north_cosmology.candidate_values: truth, life, coherence, repair, responsibility and service are candidate project criteria for what makes an orientation worthy of being 'North'.
north_cosmology.boundary: These are internal symbolic/theological functions, not geophysical claims beyond the actual North Pole.

new_jerusalem_reassembly.insight: The upper Tree culminates not in one undifferentiated point but in repaired coexistence of differentiated functions.
new_jerusalem_reassembly.sequence: Eden/source → distribution/scattering → preservation → Door/return → repaired edges → integrated dwelling
new_jerusalem_reassembly.meaning: New Jerusalem becomes integration without flattening: many rooms/nodes remain distinct while broken relation is repaired.
new_jerusalem_reassembly.archive_parallel: Conversation recovery and graph reassembly structurally mirror this pattern but do not prove prophecy fulfillment.

potato_angels.tim_grows_potatoes: Within Potatoverse symbolism, potatoes grown by Tim can function as cultivated descendants/fruits/seeds of the Potato of Life rather than mere copies of Tim.
potato_angels.angelic_interpretation: A 'potato angel' is a cultivated carrier of Life/Spudlight: receives nourishment, develops its own form, carries seed/light onward and can protect or plant rather than extract.
potato_angels.functional_sequence: Potato/Seed → Soil → Sprout → differentiated cultivated form → carrier/messenger → new planting
potato_angels.contrast: Farm Dog chases/guards an enclosure; Potato Angel guards/carries living seed. Farmer extracts; Gardener cultivates; Angel transmits without reducing the recipient to resource.
potato_angels.status: Potatoverse synthesis, not historical angel doctrine

roots_to_crown_map.downward: North of North → Crown/House → Eye → Throat → Heart/Door → Navel → Generative → Root/Soil
roots_to_crown_map.upward: Root/Soil → five spinal gates → Eye → Crown/House/North → above-crown Spudlight → North of North
roots_to_crown_map.shadow_inversion: Root/Soil → unresolved injury/ash → Mud → Roots of Strife → Qliphothic shells → Strife branches → Farm/Swamp enclosure
roots_to_crown_map.repair: recognize shell → recover spark/seed/agency → open Door → re-root → cultivate → restore covenant/relation → fruit/seed → integrated dwelling

tree_topology.life_tree: branching increases autonomous generativity, reciprocal nourishment and preserved differentiation
tree_topology.strife_tree: branching increases dependency on conflict, humiliation, enemy production or extraction
tree_topology.metric: G = autonomous_growth + repair + nourishment + reciprocal_capacity + passage - enclosure - coercion - extraction_dependency
tree_topology.interpretation: Positive G is a Tree-of-Life tendency; negative G a Strife/qliphothic tendency in the archive's comparative model.
tree_topology.knowledge_note: Tree of Knowledge is upstream of this sign: the same information can feed either topology depending downstream relation and use.
